Chapter 654: Chapter 4: Does The Tower Master Want Me To Hone My Skills On The Galaxy Master? (5000 Words, Please Subscribe)_2

Chapter 654: Chapter 4: Does the Tower Master Want Me to Hone My Skills on the Galaxy Master? (5000 words, please subscribe)_2

Crossing a Great Realm leads to a transformative evolution of the Inner World, and a completely independent Inner World undergoes a transformation far greater than those still attached to the Main Universe.

If Lin Yuan had comprehended the Rule of Time at the Ninth Rank, making his Inner World “independent,” he would have had two opportunities for transformation upon breaking through to the Tenth Rank and then the Eleventh Rank.

In this regard, he would outstrip those Eleventh Rank Powerhouses who only comprehend the Rule of Time at Eleventh Rank by a large margin.

Eleventh Rank Powerhouses who grasp the Rule of Time and integrate it into their Inner World, achieving “independence,” but their “independent” Inner Worlds lack the transformations experienced in the earlier stages, are fundamentally weaker.

When striving for the Twelfth Rank and aiming for the ultimate sublimation of their Inner Universe, the difficulty naturally increases significantly.

“I’ll try as best as I can.”

...

Lin Yuan thought to himself that there were records in human civilization of Tenth Rank Evolvers who comprehended the Rule of Time and then progressed to the Eleventh Rank, enhancing the foundation of their Inner World.

But a Ninth Rank Evolver understanding the Rule of Time? At least Lin Yuan had not heard of such a thing.

Ninth Rank Evolvers could barely perceive minor Time Fluctuations, so for them to fully grasp the Rule of Time was somewhat a tall order.

“Just a little more, and I will be able to comprehend this time model…” Lin Yuan continued exploring the concept deeply.

A moment later.

Lin Yuan ceased his contemplation.

“It’s time to visit the Demon Jade Space, and take on the fifth layer.” Utilizing the Magic Jade Mark, Lin Yuan descended into the Demon Jade Space.

The fifth layer of the Black Tower tests the perception of Time Rules, and according to Stone Statue Shen Ji, one must completely understand the Time Rules to pass.

Lin Yuan still had some way to go before fully grasping the Time Rules, but attempting the fifth layer and utilizing the various time environments within might allow him to comprehend the last Time Rule Model.

Although the Xia Qin Supreme Being told Lin Yuan that he could ask him about any cultivation problems, Lin Yuan preferred not to bother a Supreme Being unless he truly hit a bottleneck.

The last Time Model that troubled Lin Yuan, he didn’t consider it to be a bottleneck that could impede him for long.

Whoosh.

In front of the Nine Floors Dark Tower.

Stone Statue Shen Ji looked at Lin Yuan and probed, “Attempting the fifth layer?”

“Yes,” Lin Yuan nodded.

“Go ahead.” Stone Statue Shen Ji thought for a moment, then opened the gates of the Black Tower, allowing Lin Yuan to enter.

Hum.

The fifth layer of the Black Tower.

Lin Yuan’s figure appeared.

Whirling.

Time Fluctuations surged, and various extreme time flows immediately overwhelmed him.

Thirty years ago, Lin Yuan couldn’t have lasted long; the last time he had breezed through the third and fourth layers and tried the fifth, he had retreated in an instant.

But now?

Nearly grasping all Time Rule Models, although Lin Yuan still had no hope of passing the fifth layer, he at least could endure for a significant part.

If he chose not to push forward, he might even endure indefinitely.

“Hmm… My understanding of the Time Rules has advanced by leaps and bounds; grasping them completely isn’t far off…”

Outside the Black Tower, Stone Statue Shen Ji watched carefully with no hint of shock in his heart.

In just two to three decades, Lin Yuan had reached such heights in the domain of Time Rules, an inconceivable feat even for an Eleventh-Rank Life, let alone for a Ninth Rank being like Lin Yuan.

But having interacted with Lin Yuan for so long, Stone Statue Shen Ji had almost grown used to Lin Yuan continually shattering various miracles.

As Stone Statue Shen Ji watched the scenes in the fifth layer.

Suddenly.

He seemed to sense something.

An expression of surprise crossed his face.

At the same time, he looked in another direction of the Demon Jade Space.

…

Amidst the misty fog.

A sliver of Spirit Will descended.

“I…” The Spirit Will took the shape of a burly man over three meters tall, his eyes excited as he looked around.

“Is this the Demon Jade Space?” The burly man carefully surveyed the surrounding fog.

He hailed from a prominent evolutionary family in the Northern Star Region of human civilization, a peerless genius renowned across dozens of Star Domains.

About a hundred years ago, human civilization revealed part of the body to select geniuses, and from then, the burly man began to piece together an Evolution Path from within that body.

After endless efforts and with considerable luck, the burly man finally managed to complete the Evolution Path he had pieced together and, deep within his soul, condensed the Magic Jade Mark.

“The Goddess of Wisdom told me that by completing the understood Evolution Path, I would enter a Mysterious Space, where great opportunities await.”

The burly man’s heart thrilled, and he immediately followed the fog deeper inside.

Before long.

The burly man arrived in front of the towering Nine Floors Dark Tower.

“Another one has come?” Stone Statue Shen Ji glanced at the burly man and immediately knew how the latter became a member of the Magic Jade Tower.

“Just the most ordinary completion of a certain magical Evolution Path?” Stone Statue Shen Ji shook his head internally.

The difference was too great compared to Lin Yuan, who had initially comprehended three thousand three hundred and thirty-three magical Evolution Paths, like a chasm between heaven and earth.

Moreover, Lin Yuan was no longer just an ordinary member of the Magic Jade Tower but a core member.

“Elder…” Seeing Stone Statue Shen Ji, the burly man cautiously asked.

“Hmm, here’s some information about this place.” Stone Statue Shen Ji raised his right hand and infused the information into the burly man’s mind.

“Oof…” The burly man furrowed his brows, easing after a moment.

“The Nine Floors Dark Tower, the first layer, the second layer, the third layer…” The burly man looked at the towering Black Tower in front of him, his expression showing a trace of shock.

“Wait a moment, someone else is currently attempting it,” Stone Statue Shen Ji glanced at the burly man and said casually.
